svg.title: Client Clean Architecture layers
svg.desc: Four layers with inward code dependencies. The admin panel provides its own adapters and imports application and domain directly.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 395px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Frameworks and drivers
Mobile app · Expo / React Native
Skia, audio and composition root
SQLite (provisional) and HTTP client

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 395px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Frameworks and drivers
Admin web panel · React / Vite
Own HTTP and draft-storage adapters

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 395px; text-align: center; width: 395px;

span.p:
3 · Interface adapters
Presenters, input mapping and board projection
Repository adapters, DTO mappers and state serialization

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 395px; text-align: center; width: 395px;

span.p:
2 · Application / Use cases
StartGameUseCase, ApplyMoveUseCase, FinishGameUseCase
Use-case decorators and ports (e.g. IProgressRepository)

div.style: color: rgb(20, 36, 58) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 395px; text-align: center; width: 395px;

span.p:
1 · Domain / Entities
Board, GameEngine and variant rules
Geometry, scoring, piece sources, progress and events
